problem: Meetings were seen as eating into productive work time.
title: Shopify cancels recurring meetings across the company
context: Shopify employees spent large amounts of time in recurring meetings.
decision_made: Remove all recurring meetings with more than two people, limit large meetings and set meeting-free days.
action_taken: Announced in January 2023, with a cooling-off period before meetings could be re-added.
observed_outcome: Shopify said the purge freed more than 76,500 hours. Experts quoted in coverage were divided on whether it would raise productivity.
lessons: A hard reset of meetings can reveal which ones matter, but the benefit depends on what replaces them.
limitations: Hours freed is a company claim, not a measured productivity result. No follow-up outcome was found.

claims.claim_text: Shopify removed recurring meetings with more than two people.
Experts were divided on whether cancelling meetings makes staff happier or more productive.
